name: Can I replace my tankless water heater myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my tankless water heater myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a tankless water heater involves working with gas lines, high-voltage electricity, and water connections, which can be complex and dangerous without proper training. Incorrect installation can lead to safety hazards, void warranties, and potentially cause water damage or gas leaks. We strongly recommend professional installation to ensure safety, proper function, and adherence to all local plumbing codes in areas like Henderson and Summerlin.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY replacement is not recommended due to safety risks involving gas, electricity, and water; professional installation ensures safety and code compliance.
